findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: "Вимова однакова, значення розрізняє лише графічний наголос."
findings.description: The explanation erases the stress distinction: verbal sé is tonic, while pronominal se is atonic. They share their segmental sounds, but their pronunciation in connected speech is not identical in stress.
findings.suggestion: Explain that the sounds are the same but stress differs: "Sé — наголошена форма дієслова saber, а займенник se — ненаголошений. На письмі їх розрізняємо знаком наголосу: sé / se."

items.reviewerAnswer: Sé is the stressed first-person present form of saber; pronominal se is unstressed and has no written accent.
items.notes: The examples and written forms themselves are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter II, treatment of tilde diacrítica in monosyllables, including sé/se and tonic versus atonic words (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[1].blocks[0].text: "Завтра я сідаю на потяг о дев’ятій."
findings.description: El tren de las nueve identifies the nine-o'clock train by its scheduled departure. The translation instead attaches nine o'clock to the speaker's boarding action, losing the distinction between de las nueve and a las nueve.
findings.suggestion: Preserve the train's departure time: "Завтра я їду потягом, що відправляється о дев’ятій."

items.notes: The conjugation key, error feedback and Spanish reveal are correct.
sources: Packet task.prompt[1].text: "Mañana ___ (coger, yo) el tren de las nueve."
Review duties: check wrong meaning and translations.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española (2009), treatment of prepositional noun modifiers and temporal adjuncts (from memory).
